symptoms.symptom: Dryer shakes or makes noise

causes.label: Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly
remedies:  Move dryer to an even floor space, or adjust leveling legs as necessary until even.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes take too long to dry

causes.label: Improper or obstructed ducting
remedies:  Check the Installation Instructions to make sure the dryer venting is correct.  Make sure ducting is clean, free of kinks and unobstructed.  Check to see if outside wall damper operates easily.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Improper or obstructed ducting"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies:  Separate heavy items from lightweight items (generally, a well-sorted washer load is a well-sorted dryer load).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)
remedies:  Large, heavy fabrics contain more moisture and take longer to dry.
Separate large, heavy fabrics into smaller loads to speed drying time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)"

causes.label: Overloading/combining loads
remedies:  Do not put more than one washer load in the dryer at a time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Overloading/combining loads"

causes.label: Underloading
remedies:  If you are drying only one or two items, add a few items to ensure proper tumbling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Underloading"

symptoms.symptom: The DRY dryness level was chosen but load is still damp

causes.label: Load consists of a mixture of heavy and light fabrics
remedies:  When combining heavy and light fabrics in a load, choose More Dry if you are using a sensor cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Load consists of a mixture of heavy and light fabrics"

causes.label: Exhaust system is blocked
remedies:  Inspect and clean exhaust system.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Exhaust system is blocked"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer doesn’t start

causes.label: Control panel is “asleep”
remedies:  This is normal.
Press Power to activate the control panel.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Control panel is “asleep”"

causes.label: Dryer is unplugged
remedies:  Make sure the dryer plug is pushed completely into the outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Dryer is unplugged"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped
remedies:  Check the building’s fuse/circuit breaker box and replace fuse or reset breaker.
NOTE: Electric dryers use two fuses or breakers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Dryer was accidentally paused when starting Delay Dry
remedies:  If the light on the Delay Dry pad is flashing, the dryer is paused.
Press Start to restart the countdown.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Dryer was accidentally paused when starting Delay Dry"

symptoms.symptom: No numbers displayed during cycle, only lights

causes.label: Dryer is continuously monitoring the amount of moisture in the clothes
remedies:  This is normal.
When the dryer senses a low level of moisture in the load, the dryer will display the dry time remaining.                                                    23
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Dryer is continuously monitoring the amount of moisture in the clothes"

symptoms.symptom: Time Remaining jumped to a lower number

causes.label: The estimated time may change when a smaller load than usual is drying
remedies:  This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "The estimated time may change when a smaller load than usual is drying"

symptoms.symptom: Cannot make a selection and the dryer beeps twice

causes.label: The DRYNESS Level, Temp or OPTION that you are trying to select is incompatible with the chosen dry cycle
remedies:  This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "The DRYNESS Level, Temp or OPTION that you are trying to select is incompatible with the chosen dry cycle"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer is running but 0:00 is displayed in Time Remaining

causes.label: The Extended Tumble option was chosen
remedies:  This is normal.
During extended tumble, the time remaining is not displayed.
The Extended Tumble option lasts approximately 60 minutes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "The Extended Tumble option was chosen"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer doesn’t heat

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat
remedies:  Check the building’s fuse/circuit breaker box and replace both fuses or reset both breakers.
Your dryer may tumble if only one fuse is blown or one breaker tripped.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat"

causes.label: Gas service is off
remedies:  Make sure gas shutoff at dryer and main shutoff are fully open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Gas service is off"

causes.label: LP gas supply tank is empty or there has been a utility interruption of natural gas (gas models)
remedies:  Refill or replace tank.
Dryer should heat when utility service is restored.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "LP gas supply tank is empty or there has been a utility interruption of natural gas (gas models)"

symptoms.symptom: Inconsistent drying times

causes.label: Type of heat
remedies:  Drying time will vary according to the type of heat used.
If you recently changed from an electric to a gas (natural or LP) dryer, or vice versa, the drying time could be different.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Type of heat"

causes.label: Type of load and drying conditions
remedies:  The load size, types of fabric, wetness of clothes and the length and condition of the exhaust system will affect drying times.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Type of load and drying conditions"

symptoms.symptom: Glow at the rear of the drum

causes.label: Heaters behind the drum
remedies:  This is normal.
Under certain drying conditions and room ambient lighting, the glow of the heaters may be visible at the rear of the drum.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Heaters behind the drum"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes are wrinkled

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies:  Select a shorter drying time.  Remove items while they still hold a slight amount of moisture.
Select a Less Dry or Damp setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Overdrying"

symptoms.symptom: Static occurs

causes.label: No fabric softener was used
remedies:  Try a fabric softener.  Bounce® Fabric Conditioner Dryer Sheets have been approved for use in all GE Dryers when used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "No fabric softener was used"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies:  Try a fabric softener.  Adjust setting to Less Dry or Damp.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static
remedies:  Try a fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static"

symptoms.symptom: Collars and waistbands still wet at end of cycle

causes.label: The dryness monitor senses that the body of the clothes is dry
remedies:  Choose Speed Dry or Time Dry to dry damp collars and waistbands.
In the future, when drying a load with collars and waistbands, choose More Dry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "The dryness monitor senses that the body of the clothes is dry"

symptoms.symptom: Slight variation in metallic color

causes.label: This is normal
remedies:  Due to the metallic properties of paint used for this unique product, slight variations of color may occur due to viewing angles and lighting conditions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "This is normal"

symptoms.symptom: Door is too foggy to see clothes during a steam cycle

causes.label: Steam condenses on inner door
remedies:  This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Steam condenses on inner door"

symptoms.symptom: Water seen on inside of door and top of lint filter when opening door after steam cycle

causes.label: Steam condenses on these surfaces
remedies:  This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Steam condenses on these surfaces"

symptoms.symptom: Small amount of water on floor in front of dryer

causes.label: Inadequate load size for steam cycle selected, excess steam condenses inside cabinet and leaks out
remedies:  If using the Steam DeWrinkle cycle, manually reduce cycle time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 26: "Inadequate load size for steam cycle selected, excess steam condenses inside cabinet and leaks out"

symptoms.symptom: Water drips from door when opened after a Steam Cycle

causes.label: Steam condenses on inner door
remedies:  This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 26: "Steam condenses on inner door"

symptoms.symptom: Cannot see steam at beginning of cycle

causes.label: Steam released at different time in cycle
remedies:  This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 26: "Steam released at different time in cycle"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer continues to tumble after display says 0:00

causes.label: Extended Tumble option was selected
remedies:  Ensure Extended Tumble option is not selected.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 26: "Extended Tumble option was selected"
